alt: Blank paper tags hanging from one ribbon, every tag turned to face you.
prompt: Editorial illustration on a calm Daylight background. One continuous satin ribbon, shading from Alliance Blue at the left to Ribbon Cyan at the right, runs in a gentle, slightly sagging line from the upper left toward the right edge, like a line strung across a bright room. From it hang five blank tags made of flat faceted paper, in pale Daylight white, soft blue-grey and Partner Navy, each tied on with a short loop of the same ribbon. Every tag is turned to face the viewer, flat and fully visible, none twisted or turned away: prices shown openly, nothing hidden. The tags differ a little in size and hang at even intervals, the largest just right of centre. Soft navy-tinted shadows fall down and to the right onto the pale ground behind them. Keep the lower left third calm and empty. Aspect about 1.08:1, safe to crop to 4:5 for mobile. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
